monetization.bundling_note: AWS and Azure sell native cloud firewalls and Netgate bundles pfSense free with hardware, but on-premises perimeter NGFWs for public bodies are not given away.

paid_market_gaps.gap: Installed-base renewal price hikes trap buyers; replacing a firewall is far harder than cancelling software.
Cross-vendor migration tools are vendor-owned (FortiConverter) or enterprise-priced, slowing switching at refresh time.

monetization.summary: Crowded, incumbent-dominated market (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point) bought via tenders. No room for a new firewall; a narrow opening exists for vendor-neutral renewal benchmarking, licence optimization and migration tooling for European public buyers.

threat.reason: Firewall refresh and licence renewal is maintenance; supported perimeter limits exposure only marginally.
